book.name: Anutu Ikamke Zin Israel
book.title: Anutu Ikamke Zin Israel Ma Tizem Pataŋana Muriini

content: Zin Israel timbuk sua be tiwe Merere lene

To Yooba iso pa Mose ta kembei. Iso: “Nu niomru tom Aron, mi lutuunu bizin Nadap ziru Abiu, mi kolman tomto tel laamuru kizin Israel na, niom tana tabe kese tio ta abal i. Kese to, kombot moloŋana ri mi kelek kumbuyom ma kusuŋ pio muŋgu.
To nu itum tamen mar ma garau yo. Mi zin pakan ziŋan zin iwal biibi na, irao tise tio pepe. Timbot meleeba men.”
Yooba iso sua mi tutu kini ta boozomen tana ila ki Mose makiŋ, tona Mose imiili ma isula mi iso zin Israel pa. Iso ma tileŋ to, tilup kwon ma tiso: “Sua boozomen ta Yooba iso na, niam ko amto.”

To Mose ibeede sua ta boozomen ki Yooba ise ro pakaana. Aigule toro, mbeŋbeŋŋana na, Mose imaŋga ma indou pat pakan pa patoronŋana muriini isu abal uunu. To isuŋgun pat laamuru mi ru bekena iwe kilalan pa zin Israel un bizin laamuru mi ru.

Tona iŋgo naŋgaŋ pakan ma tila tikam buzur pakan, mi tiur sala you ma you ikan ma imap kat, bekena iwe patoronŋana pa Yooba. Mi tikam makau popoŋan pakan, to tilas mi tikan, bekena ziŋan Yooba tiparlup zin ma tiwe tamen.
Tona Mose ikam mbili tana siŋin, mi iliŋ sula timbiiri pakan. Mi kalwoono na, ikam mi itiyaryaara sala patoronŋana muriini.
To ikam ro ta sua kizin mbukŋana imbot se na, ma ipeele, mi ipaata ma zin iwal biibi tileŋ. Tileŋ makiŋ, to tiso: “Sua boozomen ta Yooba iso na, niam ko motoyam iŋgalŋgal mi amto.”

Tona Mose ikam siŋ ta imbot sula timbiiri na, mi itiyaryaara salakaala zin iwal biibi mi iso: “Siŋ tiŋgi be ipombol sua tau itiŋan Yooba tumbuk na. Sua tana imbot la tutu kini. Tana iti sombe toto, inako itiŋan Yooba taparlup ti ma tewe tamen.”
Mose ikam mbulu tana makiŋ, to ikam Aron, Nadap, Abiu, mi zin kolman tomto tel laamuru ma ziŋan tisala pa abal.
Tisala na, tire Anutu kizin Israel tau, ni imendernder sala koroŋ biibi kat ta keskeezeŋana ma kembei ta saamba i.
Ŋonoono kat. Zin kolman kizin Israel tire Anutu. Tamen ni ikam kosa sa pizin som. Tire i makiŋ to, tikan kini su lele tina.
Mose isala pa abal Sinai uteene
To Yooba iso pa Mose. Iso: “Se ŋana, to ituru tombotmbot. Pa nio aŋpun sua mi tutu tio se pat babaŋan kek, bekena aŋpaute zin Israel pa zaala tio. Mi aŋsombe aŋur pat taiŋgi ima nomom.”

Tana Mose iso pizin kolman ta kembei. Iso: “Niom kombotmbot tiŋgi mi kazza niamru Yosua. Mi Aron ziru Ur ta timbotmbot na. Sombe pataŋana sa, tona ziru irao tiurpe.” Ni iso makiŋ to, ikam silou kini Yosua mi ziru timaŋga ma tisalae ŋana. To Yosua imbot, mi Mose ruk ma isala kat ta abal ki Anutu uteene na.
To miiri tieene imar mi ilol abal ma sik.

Mi azuŋka ki Yooba iyaara sala abal uteene, mi miiri tieene ilol abal ma irao aigule lamata mi ta. Mi zin iwal biibi ki Israel ta timbot meleebe na, tirre sala pa azuŋka mi mburaana ta Yooba izzwe na, ma kembei you biibi ikanan sala abal uteene. Indeeŋe aigule iwe lamata mi ru pa, to Yooba imbot miiri tieene leleene mi iboobo sula pa Mose be ise kini.
Tana Mose isala abal uteene ta kor a, ma miiri tieene iloli. Mi imbotmbot tina ma irao aigule tomtooru.
